title: Grateful Dead Live at County Coliseum on 1973-11-23

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of a smooth, high‑energy El Paso ’73 show with standout renditions of "Row Jimmy", "He's Gone", "Eyes of the World" and a fiery "Other One".
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality that lets listeners hear every nuance of what reviewers call an exceptionally relaxed yet powerful performance. Highlights include Jerry Garcia’s soaring guitar on Row Jimmy and He’s Gone, a top‑notch jam in Eyes of the World, and a blistering Other One, all fueled by high energy throughout both sets.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (5‑star) praise both the musical performance and the pristine soundboard recording; only one outlier comment is unrelated, yielding an overall strong positive rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recording described as pristine and crystal‑clear; no dropout issues noted. Some listeners debate the presence of keyboards (Keith vs Brent), but mix remains balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set praised for smooth, relaxed playing and extra flair on cowboy songs; second set described as a rocking start‑to‑finish with strong jams and energetic transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly noted for fine form, intense shredding, and soaring guitar tone throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Mixed comments – some hear Keith on keys, others claim it’s Brent Mydland; keyboards are audible but identity is disputed.
